name: RunActionsTab

states.name: Action Log Viewing
states.description: Developers use this page to inspect the full sequence of GUI actions that were executed during an automation run. Every click, type, scroll, and hover is recorded and displayed in a table format. The user needs to quickly scan the action list to understand the automation flow, identify where things went right or wrong, and correlate actions with the visual state of the target application at each point.

states.name: Action Failure Debugging
states.description: When GUI automation actions fail (element not found, click missed, unexpected dialog), developers need to quickly identify which action failed and why. The action log should make failures visually prominent and provide enough context to diagnose the root cause without switching to other tools. This is the primary debugging workflow for visual automation issues.

states.name: Empty State Handling
states.description: Not all workflow runs produce GUI actions. Runs that are purely AI-driven (command and prompt workflows) will have no action log entries. The page should clearly communicate this to the developer so they do not mistake an empty log for a bug. The empty state should be informative and suggest that the run may not have included GUI automation steps.

description: Run Actions page (dev-only) — a detailed log of every GUI automation action executed during a workflow run. Shows clicks, keystrokes, scrolls, and other low-level actions with their status, coordinates, and screenshots.
